The school's Amitié program is designed to help foster new friendships that will last a lifetime. This is why Suoh Shirahane, a painfully shy girl with a mysterious past, has enrolled. As her first year of high school begins, she is filled with hopes of a new life.

title.romaji: Otto no Joushi ni Moteasobareru Dekajiri Jeans Tsuma

title.english: Lady Knight Rahel and The Silvery Forest Fang
title.native: 女騎士ラーエルと錫色の森の牙
title.romaji: Onnakishi Rael to Suzuiro no Mori no Kiba

175101.description:
"With this reality-bending ability, I will reshape the surroundings of my dull and gray youth!"

A calm, cool-headed "little brother" who's good at cooking.
A cowardly "male childhood friend" who needs to be watched over.
A "male junior ace" from the soccer club who's got a big ego.
I refuse to have my youth be defined by them, so without further ado...

I turned my bratty little brother into a cute and family-oriented little sister.
I turned my meek male childhood friend into the type of girl anyone would want to protect.
I turned my cocky male junior into a cheeky female sports club manager.
The finishing touches are simple.

While the three of them are confused after their sudden genderswap, I will carve the reality that "You are a female." into their bodies, making sure they fall.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: こいつらみんな女の子なら良いのに(※なった)

175102.description:
Uzuki has been a shy crybaby ever since he was little. He had a single friend named Haruto, who he considered his hero. However, their relationship took a turn when they entered high school, and Uzuki found himself alone once again. That's when they were suddenly kidnapped by a group of men and forced to participate in a death game. What will happen to Uzuki and Haruto? And who is real mastermind behind these events?

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

Note: Ura Kazuki and Eguchi Takuya acted out the story as Uzuki and Haruto respectively on Okamoto Nobuhiko's radio show, Okamoto Nobuhiko no Oyatsu Time (岡本信彦のおやつタイム).

175105.description: Hijami's unconventional way in dealing with cases has the citizens wondering if the town's public safety can be protected by a cop who is a former motorcycle gang member.

175106.description:
Several decades ago, the young boy Bai Ze wandered into the mountains of the immortal realm and formed a bond with a young immortal. Back in the present day, the college student Bai Ze once again comes to the immortal realm, only to find that the handsome immortal of his dreams has become a pitiful figure, forgotten by the mortal realm. In a world where demons and monsters wreak havoc, the source of the trouble turns out to be this pitiful thing. Trying to make things right, Bai Ze forcefully brings the immortal back to the mortal realm with him, looking for his help to restore the peace. After all, who could resist someone so beautiful, powerful, yet pitiful?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: In the Name of Bai Ze

175107.description:
A whimsical love story of men and women who live in Kirakuso, a run-down, 70-year-old apartment building. A female civil servant nearing her thirties. A former elite salaryman, now unemployed. A young woman living life at double-speed. A shoujo manga editor who has never a girlfriend in his 27 years. A mysterious fortune-teller. A no-good bartender with two kids and two divorces. This is an assortment of love stories woven by these six wonderful and fearless people!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Volume includes three additional one-shots.
synonyms: メジロ３代の奇跡を継ぐ者 メジロマックイーン
わが猫道楽人生に悔いなし

title.native: アパートの鍵あいてます

175108.description:
"My dream is to train the horse that will win the Derby."

Sara has just returned from studying in the United States. She lied to her parents that she was studying business administration, but in reality she was secretly learning to be a horse trainer. On the day she returned to Japan, Takara Hero, a horse trained by her father and grandfather, was running in the lead. Just as the crowed was convinced that Takara Hero was going to win, he got spooked and threw off his jockey before the finish line, losing the race. The audience was in an uproar: "It's a rigged race! The race was investigated and analyzed from a variety of angles, including video footage.......

(Source: Sukima, translated)

175109.description: A special comic, newly drawn by Fuyumi Soryo in collaboration with an exhibition, depicting a confrontation between Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo.

title.native: チェーザレ 破壊の創造者 特別編 二人の巨匠
title.romaji: Cesare: Hakai no Souzousha Tokubetsu-hen, Futari no Kyoshou

175110.description:
Based on game DNF, the story tells the legends of the planet Arad. Great warriors come and go, as their stories unfold. Each may seem to be an independent tale, but their fates are intertwined, as they guard Arad through the past, present and future of the world. No matter if we fight alone or side by side, we will fight with the true heart of a warrior!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

175111.description:
Akari Machino, influenced by her grandfather who was a movie buff, eats all kinds of gourmet foods that appear in famous movies! This is a cinema gourmet story!

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

175112.description: A romantic comedy that explores the love affair between a high school student and a teacher. Caught in the dilemma of their teacher-student relationship, they must conceal their marriage, leading to various conflicts.

175113.description:
When Anais wakes up, she finds Octavian, King of Barbier, by her side. He tells her they are husband and wife, and he is devoted to her, even though she has lost her memory. Anais is overwhelmed by his tenderness, sweet kisses, and hot caresses, and she is unable to think deeply about the situation. She tries to recall her memory, but Octavian insists that she does not need to force herself to remember, and dotes on her even more fiercely. He even prepared a fantastic hanging garden as a gift for Anais, "all for the sake of my beloved wife." Anais spends her days without contact with the outside world, but she soon discovers that Octavian is hiding something from her.

(Source: Dolce Comic, translated)

title.native: 溺愛王は亡国の王女を逃がさない～ふしだらな蜜月と高潔の契り～
title.romaji: Dekiai Ou wa Boukoku no Oujo wo Nigasanai: Fushidarana Mitsugetsu to Kouketsu no Chigiri

175114.description:
"You are Anais. We are husband and wife."

When Anais wakes up after losing her memory, Octavian pampers her with hot kisses that lulls her into complacency. The more Anais tries to remember, the more intensely Octavian's caresses become, and the more she is consumed by the pleasure of it. But then she discovers that Octavian is deliberately hiding her past from her.

(Source: Vanilla Bunko, translated)

title.native: 溺愛王は亡国の王女を逃がさない～ふしだらな蜜月と高潔の契り～
title.romaji: Dekiai Ou wa Boukoku no Oujo wo Nigasanai: Fushidarana Mitsugetsu to Kouketsu no Chigiri

175115.description:
Despite being the most powerful saint, Tia was accused of being a heretic and banished from the royal capital. She became the teacher for three girls who had failed as candidate saints.

"Sensei, if you fly into the capital on a dragon, will you get into trouble!"
"This is all sensei's fault!! What the hell was that?"
"I want to be the strongest too. Please teach me, sensei?"

The "combination" of their talents and Tia's saintly magic will lead to extraordinary results, ranging from the ultra-fast cultivation of crops to raising dragons to one-on-one combat.

I will guide you with all my knowledge.
The girls who adore their saintly teacher grow up to become the strongest saints themselves, surprising even their own country!

(Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)
synonyms: The saintly teacher's witchcraft is progressive!

title.native: 聖女先生の魔法は進んでる！
title.romaji: Seijo Sensei no Mahou wa Susunderu!

175116.description:
An extra story for the "Boku no Suki na Senpai" series.

The two of them go on vacation to a southern island all by themselves.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Released at Comiket 86.

175117.description:
Driving while drowsy: will you crash, or will you embark on an adventure...?

Prize winning debut oneshot from the fourth round of the Yatagarasuhai Competition published in the Harta magazine's March 2023 Issue No.102.
synonyms: After the Night Shift, Fun at the Beach.

175118.description:
I've just gotten a nice, new apartment, but there's an unexpected lodger living rent-free in my refrigerator!

Prize winning debut oneshot from the fourth round of the Yatagarasuhai "Yatagarasu Cup" Competition published in Harta magazine's December 2022 Issue No.100.

175119.description:
Hana Ichise is from a branch family to one of five barrier-weaving magical clans who protect and support Japan. But in the eyes of her mother and father, she’s an afterthought compared to her talented older twin sister. When Hana’s true potential awakens at age fifteen, she decides to keep her newfound abilities a secret—including from her parents—so she can have a quiet life. But the powerful new head of the elite Ichinomiya clan, Saku Ichinomiya, is looking for a bride…and he has his eyes on Hana!

(Source: Yen Press)

175122.description:
Lin Dao, the Emperor of Heaven, in his pursuit of the Supreme Blade Heart technique, dissipated his cultivation to start anew. However, he was betrayed by Wang Xian'er, and his throne usurped. On the brink of death, Lin Dao reached enlightenment of the Supreme Blade, and he hid away his soul to lay dormant for thousands of years. When he reawakened, he reincarnated into the body of an overlooked disciple of the Heavenly Sword Sect. The unwanted disciple was sent to the Divine Blade Sect as a scapegoat sacrifice. Lin Dao took advantage of the opportunity, and established himself in the Divine Blade Sect as his base, meticulously preparing his revenge against Wang Xian'er. Subsequently, Lin Dao annihilated the Heavenly Sword Sect, defeated the Soul Annihilation Hall, and forcefully unified the three major continents. This forced the ones behind the conspiracy, the Azure Cloud Sect, to finally reveal themselves as the force that controlled Wang Xian'er. The final confrontation between two empires is about to began.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

"I've been looking for you all my life, but you...you don't remember me?" Within the back alleys of futuristic Jin-gwang district, Kangtae is the ultimate street fighter and task rabbit; an enhanced human with animalistic abilities, he is able to accomplish things most people find impossible. But these powers come with a cost: just like his bestial counterparts, Kangtae is forced into ruts when his wild side takes over. To make matters worse, Kangtae runs into mysterious-yet-alluring Rion—a Virtual World designer who claims to have known him in his youth. As the two explore their history together, they discover a romance nouveau only possible in this new age of humanity...

(Source: Lezhin US)

175126.description:
Ten years have passed since Mafuyu and Ritsuka graduated from high school and made their professional debut with their band, Given. Both have continued to thrive as professional musicians, with Ritsuka also busily supporting Hiragi and Shizusumi’s band, syh. The two have argued, run away from home, and made up under the covers, and ten years of their lives have passed in a dazzling blur. This precious epilogue depicts their current lives, their growth, and the important people surrounding them.

(Source: SuBLime)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

175127.description:
Marienne is simply perplexed at her husband Duke Alexias's extreme shift in behavior. He's known for his cruelty. Marienne, too, has received nothing from him but neglect since their engagement. She's resigned herself to being a mistreated prisoner in his home. So then, why? Why would he suddenly profess his love to her and propose to her in earnest? Especially since they're ALREADY married?!

A bejeweled bouquet of flowers, courtship akin to that of a fairy tale prince, being addressed as his GODDESS?! There seems to be no end. But despite Marienne's bewilderment, Alexia's sincerity somehow cuts through his bungling displays, and his words of affection begin to thaw her lonely heart.

Unbeknownst to Marienne, her once ruthless and unfeeling husband has "returned" from the brink of death. But what could've caused this change of heart? Why is he so desperate to ensure her happiness? And most importantly, will he be able to do right by Marienne this time?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

175128.description:
"Why are you acting like you love me so much?"

Mariene is troubled by the sudden transformation of her cold-hearted and ruthless husband, Duke Alexia. She had been living a solitary life confined to his mansion, stuck in a loveless marriage, until one day he came to propose love to her, doting on her as "my goddess"! He presents her with a bouquet of flowers, drapes her in jewels, and woos her with all the heart-pounding techniques of romance novels. His clumsy but straightforward acts of love starts to thaw her frozen heart. But... Mariene still doesn't know why he acts like he loves her. Is this a temporary condition? What made him change his mind? The cold-blooded prince who found love by returning from the dead and an unloved lady of the goddess will begin their second-chance, doting love fantasy!

Komaki is Wakaba's oldest friend from her childhood. She is kind, athletic, smart...people even call her "a flawless beauty." However, Wakaba knows her real personality...evil, cruel, looks down on people. Wakaba wanted to show her that she is not special. They made a bet...the one who got the higher score in their midterm wins. The bet was Wakaba's idea, but it was Komaki's idea to put their dignity on the line. Wakaba lost. Komaki declared that on every bet after this, she will get to have Wakaba's precious things...first experiences. She asked for Wakaba's first kiss...then... Wakaba hates Komaki, but whenever she loses, she finds a new side of her feelings. What is this feeling...? And why does Komaki wants her so badly?

Jae-Hyeon's life was ruined by his stepmother, the woman who drove his mother to death and later caused his father's downfall. Consumed by hatred and forbidden desire, he takes revenge on her, only to die in a tragic accident. But fate has other plans... Awakening 25 years in the past, before his family’s destruction began, Jae-Hyeon must change the course of his life. Will he break free from his past, or repeat the same twisted destiny?

"The empire is at peace only when an empress with brilliant golden locks is at the side of the emperor."

In the Empire of Oriet, every reign is marked by the birth of a single blonde woman who is worthy of being the emperor’s consort. Thanks to this multiple century-long legend, the empire has prospered. However, unable to obtain a blonde consort, the current emperor was forced to marry a vicous dark-haired empress. Without their blonde beauty, the empire is facing its slow decline. Meanwhile, the second prince, Carlix, loses in the race to become the next emperor. Forced into a marriage to a woman who doesn’t even show up to their wedding, Carlix is made even more furious after being publicly disrespected by her father, the duke. But then, as if by fate, Carlix stumbles upon a stunning blonde beauty. Will he be able to seduce her and steal her throne?

“Give unto me your heart and body…”

The extremely hideous Joonyoung finds himself duped into an unfair contract with a mischievous succubus. To survive, he must seduce women, a daunting task for someone like him. However, he’s granted a unique superpower to aid in his mission: the ability to become invisible! With this newfound skill, Joonyoung navigates a world of unseen opportunities and challenges, all while trying to outsmart the supernatural forces at play. Can he master the art of invisibility and turn the odds in his favor, or will the succubus's game prove too dangerous?

175185.description:
In a world ruled by the absolute authority of the Pontiff, Saintess Lillia stands against the exploitation of the people. Yet, she is cast aside and deemed unnecessary by the so-called divine one. Betrayed and discarded, she is reduced to slavery, her name stained by whispers of corruption. Shunned and abandoned, no one dares to help her—until the Grand Duke, Deus Selion, steps in to save her. Could this Grand Duke be the divine messenger destined to save the empire and its people, as Lillia had foretold?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Intrigued, Taenyeo decides to go with the flow, but things get complicated when another classmate catches her eye. He's equally stunning, with intense eyes and a perfect physique. Torn between two equally attractive men, Taenyeo faces the dilemma of choosing one...but why not try them both before making a decision?

175230.description:
The story opens with Azami, the protagonist, killing his father who abused him, then a gorgeous girl who introduces herself as Beniko shows up, taking the blame for the murder and ridding Azami of any suspicion, as she's seen fleeing the scene of the crime.

After a while, Azami meets Beniko, who reveals herself to actually be Naoki, a crossdressing boy, shocking Azami. Naoki had seen through Azami's resentment toward society in the previous incident and invites him to join him in conquering society through the power of money.

Thus, ending the first chapter with Azami's statement of "Money is everything! I will take revenge on those who made fun of me!"

175240.description:
Yuya Amae, an office worker in his third year of work, is completely exhausted from the daily grind. Until one day, Yuya is reunited with Shiratori Aoi, a girl eight years younger from his old neighborhood. Seeing her for the first time in seven years, she has grown into a beautiful high school girl who is good at housework, too.

"Yuya-kun, can I stay with you… with the premise of eventual marriage?"

Aoi wants to live together with Yuya, her first love. Yuya is confused by her sudden proposal, but he agrees to the cohabitation arrangement, but only as her guardian for now. However, Aoi's seductive approach will cause his resolve to waver!?

A rare male calico cat was raised in an over-protective environment, which caused him to have no friends. So Sanmou decides to leave home and move into the student dormitory to make more friends at university. He tries to be friendly with his roommate Hasuki, who is a Siberian husky, which is suppose to have a friendly personality…

The start of many "first" experiences with new friends!

175242.description:
His girlfriend is so gorgeous that every guy turns to look at her. But this relationship is fake...then why does she look so happy to be with him, an average guy who is not good at anything!?

Seiji entered Souhou Academy, where the wealthiest families send their children, after he passed the transfer exam. A new student was rare, so he had been spending his high school days in solitude...until the day a girl asked him to be a fake boyfriend of her sister. If she doesn't have one, their mother will go find a fiancé, the girl says. Her sister, Sara, was a cool beauty from a wealthy family, admired by everyone in the Academy. Seiji couldn't understand why he was chosen but accepted the offer. From that day, he started to spend time with her. Although it was supposed to be a fake relationship, Sara looked like she is actually enjoying being with him. Seiji became confused about what Sara wants from him... A bizarre love comedy!!!

175247.description:
You realize that these aren't just obligatory chocolates, right?

Obligatory chocolate is the kind that you give to people you don't even like, just because it's a Valentine's Day tradition. Aya, a beautiful office lady who is often misunderstood because of her lack of visible emotions, was complaining about it to her boss Takaki, as they walked to the train station together after work. However, Takaki told her, "That's too bad, because I was really looking forward to getting chocolates from Aya, even if it's just obligatory…"

As they parted ways, Aya hands Takaki a box of chocolates. Takaki is confused, because he thought she didn't like giving out obligatory chocolates…

"Senpai, are you really that dumb?"

Winner of the 3rd Toaru Nichijou Manga Award, it's a sweet romantic comedy that will satisfy your heart and your sweet tooth!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

175249.description:
Working as Nikos's secretary, Anna soon found herself in his bed...and pregnant with his child. Anna's love for Nikos carried her to this point, but after the pregnancy she felt as though Nikos was distancing himself from her. He drove her and their baby away...and he hired a new secretary to take Anna's place.! Later Nikos comes after Anna to reclaim his baby, but she isn't about to give him up without a fight. So she goes back with Nikos to try to keep her child. As she spends time with Nikos and starts to see him as a father, her love for him grows. But when Nikos decides to hire another woman to be his secretary, she tries to find a way to leave through an old family friend. Nikos is trying to figure out his feelings for Anna, but will he figure them out in time to save them both?

(Source: Renta!)

175251.description:
Her distinctive fashion is based on pink and black, with plenty of ribbons and frills. Amane Raihara may seem like the landmine-type, but the high school girl is actually sensitive and caring on the inside. Her secret desire: "I want someone to pamper me!"

After a series of incidents, I confesses my feelings to Amane, a regular customer at my part-time job. She says that it's hard for her to trust other people, and nobody has really ever truly cared about her… In order to make her happy, we do whatever she wants: play at the game center, go on a date at the festival, and dote on her to the fullest!

“Is it really okay to feel so spoiled?”

It's an intimate time with just me and my landmine-girl.

175253.description:
On the morning of waking up with a hangover, college student Oto receives a suspicious message with a picture of himself with his clothes off, a message from someone he doesn't remember...! "Is this...Have I been fucked ......?" Oto finds out that the message is from Kanata Mifune, a student in the education department, and decides to go to see him with the big hope of having the photo data erased, but Kanata, on the other hand, puts on a fresh face and forcefully enters Oto's house. Once again, Oto, who is a bit easily charmed, accidentally drinks too much alcohol and gets tipsy... Kanata cheerfully asks Otone to go out with him, but Oto has a past history of failing badly in love. The trauma of that experience is slowly beginning to bite him in the ass...!

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Chapter counts include extra chapters.

175255.description: Note: Won an honorable mention for Shonen Magazine's 111th upcoming mangaka awards.

175257.description:
In order to protect the lands of humans from the Demi-human tribes of the macaques and orgs, a young boy named Kai rages onto the battlefield. In the midst of a battle one day, Kai suddenly remembers memories of his past life. Memories that are more advanced than the world he currenlty lives in. Kai returns safely to the village and begins to recall his memories, awakening new powers along the way, but soon after, finds himself in a deadly battle with an org after receiving a near-fatal wound... In a world where humans, Demi-humans, and gods mingle, a story of a young boy's battle and growth unfolds!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

175258.description:
Chengzi said, "They ascend during the day, but I can't sleep at night."

The junior girl asked, "Why can't you sleep if others ascend?"

The prefect interjected, "Because he helps other people to ascend to immortality, while he himself is still mortal."

A moment later, Chengzi helped the prefect pass his final trial, and sent him on his way to immortality.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: My Second Senior Brother Is a Mortal But Strong

175259.description:
Classmates spend a whole year together. It is because they are so close to each other that they fall in love, and it is because they are close to each other that they are frustrated. This is an omnibus romantic comedy filled with romance between classmates, which can be amusing and quite touching.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)
synonyms: If You Want to Fall in Love, in the Classroom

title.romaji: Koi wo Suru Nara Kyoushitsu de

175261.description: Fujiyama Kensaku, also known as "Fujiken," is the strongest fighter despite being super laid-back and perverted. Along with his three friends, they immerse themselves in fighting and picking up girls in this exhilarating school drama. The dynamic storytelling of high schoolers acting on impulse, comedic scenes, and Fujiyama's formidable strength are highlighted as he defeats delinquents one after another in intense battle scenes.

175262.description:
Cyan Vert, illegitimate son of the Duke and the empire's greatest assassin, is betrayed by the righteous brother whose shadow he's always lived in. But just before the fatal blow strikes his throat, Cyan awakes to find he's just a boy again. The young lord has been reborn, and this time, he's not going to live in anyone's shadow!

(Source: WEBTOON)

175266.description:
Nakai Kawazu, who will soon be in her third year of high school, spends her days absent-mindedly being carried away by her surroundings, without any particular interests or dreams for the future.

One day, she happens to visit an aquarium and meets her classmate, Kanzaki, who has an overwhelming love for killer whales.

Lured in by Kanzaki, who talks about the charm of killer whales, she sees the performance with the killer whales for the first time, and is greatly moved by their overwhelming appearance.

175267.description:
A young man who is popular with the girls has an unpopular older brother. It's not that he dislikes his brother, but for some reason he feels particularly annoyed by the fact that his brother is unpopular.

(Source: Harta Alternative, translated)

Note: originally published as a two-part "one-shot" and started serialization on February 26th, 2024.

175268.description:
Luka was born into a prestigious family known to all wizards. However, he was considered a dropout for his lack of magical ability and treated coldly by his parents. As soon as he graduated from magic school, he was kicked out from his house. He now earns a meager living by selling medicines he concocts. One day, he happens across a phantom beast covered in wounds in the forest and treats it. The beast tells him he wants to return the favor and offers him a master-servant contract. Unable to refuse, he ends up signing a contract with Alba, the mythical carbuncle of wealth and fame.

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 落ちこぼれ魔法使いと恋する獣

175271.description:
Frederica, Old Blue, and Principal Halna clash over a powerful relic stored deep within the secret ruins underneath the old school building. A murderous intruder picks off magical-girl students one after another. Surrounded by enemies at every turn, Snow White stands before the entrance to the ruins that hold the fate of the world…and makes a critical decision. At last, Snow White’s long saga comes to a close! How will the story of this girl at the mercy of destiny conclude…? 

(Source: Yen Press)

175272.description:
An omnibus-style romance series. The first chapter, Hitomi no Shutter wo Oshite, tells the story of Shiho Meguro, a competitive girl starting her first year of high school this spring, and Narita, a senior in the photography club she happens to join by chance.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

175273.description:
"I liked that woman, but she called me a wimp. I thought to myself, I only became a thug because I'm a wimp. A wimp and a thug are two words for the same thing."

On a whim, Osamu, a low-level yakuza, takes in and hides Keiko from his fellow gang members, who were searching for her. When he wakes up in the morning, Keiko is already gone. When he goes into the office, he discovers that Keiko is a mistress of his gang boss. Eventually, Keiko is caught and she asks Osamu for help, what will he do......?

(Source: cmoa, translated)

However, the stranger turns out to be a waiter at the cafe where Kuga has been frequenting recently! Ever since then, the waiter, Sakiki, tries to chat with Kuga whenever he comes to the coffee shop.

Kuga feels awkward about having his private life known, but he is comforted by the delicious coffee and the pleasant conversation with Sakiki. Then one day, Sakiki finds out Kuga's "reason" for not having a boyfriend!

Shishido is devastated to learn that the man he thought was his lover has long already broken up with him. He drinks more and more with Ren, who kindly listens to him, but suddenly he is pushed down by Ren, who says, "I want to comfort you". When Shishido declines Ren's invitation, saying they are not in a relationship, his gentle demeanor changes and the angel turns into a demon...! He is angry at Ren for making fun of him, but he is too drunk to move and is taken care of by Ren. He is in agony over the gap between Ren's reputation and the side he shows only to him, but when he makes sure that they will never see each other alone again, they run into each other at work. However, this school turned out to be an unconventional institution with a vast dungeon underground, and all students were gathered to conquer this dungeon. 175773.description:
Rotieh Panderion has been entrusted with an important task: She must create "Nectar," an immortality-granting elixir. In return, she will be granted a position among the world's deities. After toiling away for a hundred lifetimes, she's had enough hard work and decides to go on strike! But her latest reincarnation is a poor, illegitimate princess accused of attempted murder. Now, Rotieh must clear her name and restore her lost wealth, but that's easier said than done when she doesn't wanna work!

(Source: Tapas)

175774.description:
A bodybuilder gets transported back to the Joseon dynasty. Surely, he couldn't change history with weight lifting... or could he?

(Source: Toomics)

175775.description:
Ji-Chan the alpha is a director at a conglomerate run by his gang but must fight to keep his rivals from stealing his position. Just when he's desperate to produce results, he's offered a promising business deal by Eugene, the director of a famous pharmaceutical company. However, Ji-Chan's hope turns to despair when Eugene kidnaps him and uses him as a test subject for a trait converter drug. Turned into an omega and confined against his will, Ji-Chan is forced to submit to Eugene, a merciless alpha. But why is Eugene being strangely vengeful when they barely know each other?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

175776.description:
S-class Hunter Kim Yi-Yeong can't wait to leave the novel she woke up in. She gets the chance after defeating the story's final boss, but instead of returning home, she’s sent into another novel! Yi-Yeong becomes Lady Renee Markious, a petty villainess who’s just been framed for murder. Fortunately, Yi-Yeong has a secret weapon nobody knows about… her skills from her past life! Can Yi-Yeong clear Renee's name and find her way back to her own world? Or will she be trapped in this tale for good?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

175777.description:
Seon-U's brother is found dead in the VIP room of a nightclub alongside Yu-Ra, the youngest daughter of the Seo family patriarch and a real little pest. Determined to shed light on the circumstances of the tragedy, Seon-U enters the luxurious Seo residence by being hired as Yu-Ra's personal coach and meets Mun-Do, the latter's attractive nephew, who seems to hold one of the keys to the mystery.

(Source: WEBTOONS FR, translated and edited)

175779.description:
"I love you, doctor. Be my wife."

The young ace of the orthopedic department, Sota Takara, must operate on a gangster with a Jacob's ladder piercing?! The gangster is Ibu Seiichiro, the young boss of the Ibu Group, one of the largest criminal organizations in the Kanto region! After having his leg saved, Ibu falls in love with Sota. He even kisses him and asks him to be his wife?! Can love bloom between a handsome gangster and a virgin surgeon?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

175780.description:
Sota is a young ace plastic surgeon at the university hospital. One night, a man with a full-body tattoo and a pierced penis is rushed to the hospital after a traffic accident. The man is Seiichiro Ibu, a yakuza gang boss who controls the whole Kanto region! Ibu survives, but falls in love with Sota at first sight. Ibu chases Sota around the hospital in his wheelchair, and proposes to him with a bouquet of roses accompanied by violins! Will Sota Takara, a 32-year-old virgin doctor, really get married to a younger yakuza man?

(Source: Eclair Novels, translated)

Encounter with you was sudden. And we became important to each other. So, I couldn't imagine. That you would disappear from my sight.

To everyone who said "goodbye" to their loved ones.

(Source: Office You, translated)

175819.description:
The explosion at the Geonyang chemical plant 19 years ago was not an industrial disaster. There was a secret experiment to awaken 'it' that had been sleeping underground in the city, and dangerous particles that had been dormant for hundreds of millions of years spread throughout the city through factory chimneys. A city that died in a disaster, but people still lived and children were born. The 'things' that were released to the ground in the past also coexist in the darkness of the city. The summer of 1999, when the children born the year after the accident turned 18! Once again, the secret in the darkness is about to awaken... In 1999, various mysterious events occur in a village at the turn of the century. Fearless girls and children who investigate the case, and various unidentified monsters. On the contrary, the adults who try to cover up the incident and 'it', the source of everything, are revealed!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

175820.description: D.P. stands for "Deserter Pursuit", a soldier who catches deserters. Jun-Ho An, as a D.P., pursues a deserter and faces the reality of the military through the problems of each defector.

175821.description:
After completing his military service as a DP and being discharged, Ahn Jun-Ho enlists in the anti-terrorism unit as a non-commissioned officer. At the same time, a series of suspicious suicides occur in the 103rd Division, and investigator Park Beom-Gu delves into the case.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: SPT - The Time of the Bat

175822.description:
Hong Deok-Hye becomes 'Seo Na-In', the main character of the romance novel "Love is Takeout!" that she read. Unlike the ending of the novel where she becomes the lover of the main male lead, 'Cha Min-Ho', Deok-Hye dreams of love with the sub-male lead, 'Min Gyu-Hyeon'. However, her murder occurs at the cafe where Na-In works. The victim is Gyu-Hyeon's girlfriend, and the suspect is Gyu-Hyeon. Embarrassed by the developments that differ from the content of her novel, Deok-Hye searches for a way to return to the real world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

175823.description:
When he entered high school, Yamazaki had already decided to join the Film Society in order to have a good time with fellow movie fans. But when he went to the club room, he found that there were only two members: Goto-san, the president of the club, who loves George A. Romero, and Yamazaki himself. Many boys joined the club to try to get with the sexy and busty Goto-san, but Goto was so strange that all the other boys quit except for Yamazaki. Yamazaki is left all alone under the command of Goto-san...?

This is the start of a theatrical romantic comedy full of love for zombie flicks.

(Source: MangaCross, translated)

175824.description:
Genesis weapons—Heroes of the war, or dangerous threats? In Tristan, humans and mechanical lifeforms called “cobas” live side by side. Three years ago, the war finally ended, brought down by the Genesis Weapons. Ode, once a Genesis Weapon himself, investigates the secrets of the M3 company, seeking memories of his life before becoming a weapon. When he discovers children being used in experiments to create others like the Genesis Weapons, he sets out on a journey to find the comrades who escaped with him and to uncover what M3 is after.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

175825.description:
Kanako Kurasawa, a novice designer, decides to quit a black company where "self-sacrifice" is the norm, and changes jobs to a small design firm specializing in renovations. Through her work, she becomes involved in the human drama of ten different people. As Kanako sees various "people" and "homes," she begins to look at her own "way of working" and, by extension, her "way of life. This is a story of life and renovation that realistically depicts the "difficulties in living" faced by today's young people, and examines the "right way to work" in the modern age!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.romaji: Itsumo Tsukiyo ni Kome no Meshi

175826.description:
Over the years, many 2.5-dimensional stage performers based on various manga and anime have been produced, and some of them became popular idols. Masaya Kanamori was one of them. Yuko Yoshimura, a woman who just moved into a nursing home, still considers Masaya her bias, even though he suddenly "passed on" 50 years ago. She thought she would spend the rest of her life with only the memories of her idol, but―!?

(Source: Big Comics, translated)

175827.description:
Several decades have passed since the Hero defeated the Demon Lord and brought peace to the world. The Hero has grown so old that he barely remembers the incantations for his magic spells. When the remnants of the Demon Lord's army attacks the Hero, he decides to set out on a journey again. This time, it's not a journey to save the world, but a "final journey" to look back on his life.

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

Unsuccessful at finding a job, Ledo Mizugami is overjoyed when he is hired by a certain real estate company. But to his surprise, it is a real estate company that specializes in "ayakashi," and his boss is an extremely beautiful and domineering god...! A lively but peaceful story about the interwoven daily lives of ayakashi and humans.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

175844.description:
Okami is a god who takes the form of a beast and bestows "blessings'' on the lands he visits. The mountain village where this tradition remains is suffering from a never-ending snowfall all year round. The residents believe that this is due to a lack of offerings to the Okami and decide to present a slave boy as a human sacrifice to their god.

A master-servant fantasy story of a boy and beast.

175846.description:
Raizou is a man betrayed by the people he believed in and has no place to turn, when he is picked up by "REVENGER," a group who takes revenge on behalf of the powerless.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

175850.description:
The intuitive right brain and the logical left brain, the two opposing sides are responsible for human decision-making. However, a trivial incident disturbs their balance, and their peaceful daily life is disrupted...! Is it the right brain or the left brain that's in charge? This is a story of people who waver between emotion and logic.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a bonus chapter.

175852.description:
A heartwarming full-color manga about the human side of cats.

No matter how tough or sad life gets, there's always a place where you can find delicious food, sake, and the unwavering smiles of Tora-san and Mike-san. "Tora and Mike" is a dotenabe (hot pot) restaurant nestled in Nagoya. Run by elder sister Tora, who handles the finances, and her younger sister Mike, who takes care of cooking and customer service, the shop comes alive every night with the laughter of its regulars.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

175853.description:
“Let's be lovers only in this room."

Even though they are comedian duo, Takei suddenly stopped talking with his partner Yutaro. To find out the truth, Yutaro agrees to go on a prank show. Yutaro, as a prank, tells Takei to break the duo but Takei starts crying. Yutaro asks him the reason for his tears after the show and Takei confesses to him that he loves Yutaro. To better work out the relationship, Yutaro suggests acting as lovers only in his room until Takei is over with Yutaro. There begins the secret relationship between a comedian duo...

(Source: CLLENN)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

175855.description:
"I'm gonna come again… I'm gonna c-…" Mika Oyamada was drinking away her sorrows because her boyfriend who she'd been dating for a year and a half had cheated on her. Her younger childhood friend, Mahiro Otake, watched over her as she drank too much. He said, "You must be exhausted after all you've been through," and had her lay down and started giving her a massage. Since she trusted Mahiro after knowing him for so long, she entrusted her body to him without any worries. It was a relaxing massage at first, but Mahiro's hands gradually began to touch her sensitive areas. At first, she thought it was just her imagination, but his hands began to touch her private parts… "You're wet, Mika." With those words as a cue, Mahiro's fingers began to forcefully knead beneath Mika's underwear. Mika was forced to come because of the pleasure, but…!?

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 36 episodes and 12 chapters respectively.

175858.description:
In a future Japan where a meteor strike has brought about the end of humanity, Kaina survives a helicopter crash that claimed her family. Though she lost an arm in the accident, she was saved by a man named Kazan Aramaki. Since then, she has lived a fulfilling life with her savior deep in the mountains.

However, their peace is shattered when a man visits Kazan carrying a single "arm." This encounter warps Kaina’s destiny, sending it spiraling into overdrive.

Brought to you by the powerhouse duo of Ningen Rokudo and Keigo Anaguma, a raging post-apocalyptic Sci-Fi supernatural battle saga begins now!

(Source: Comiplex, translated)

175861.description:
As a former dropout, Regnard defies the haters and enrolls in the esteemed Royal Academy of Lasarzia. But when it comes time to receive his skill, things don’t quite go as planned. Rather than a cool skill or fantastic abilities, he gets a cuddle skill. Mocked and ridiculed for this bizarre ability, Regnard is sure he’ll be stuck as a loser. That is, until he spends the night with the beautiful honor student Frost. With his new ability unlocked, Regnard will follow the path to adventure—and build the ultimate harem!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

175862.description:
1. Aoi Mangakyou (青いマン華鏡)
Ishinomori is riding on a train to Sendai when he sees a boy near him with a blue kaleidoscope. Reminded of how he used to like them, he asks the boy to borrow it. With a glimpse, he begins to understand what made him the mangaka he is...
2. Boku no Norakuro (ボクののらくろ)
An essay manga where Ishinomori discusses the impact Norakuro left on him in the post-war period.
3. Karakou Monogatari (カラ公ものがたり)
The story of the life of a little crow who is nursed and taken care of by a group of siblings against all odds.
4. Boku no Heya ni wa Beethoven no Death Mask ga Atta (ぼくの部屋にはベートーベンのデス・マスクがあった)
Ishinomori reminisces about his relationship with Beethoven and music, as well as his time at Tokiwa-sou with Fujio Akatsuka.
5. Tokiwa-sou no Charumera (トキワ荘のチャルメラ)
Ishinomori and Akatsuka (as Akamori and Ishizuka) once more star as the focus, this time covering their experiences with the changing times, highlighted with the advent of instant ramen.
6. Tokiwa-sou Monogatari (トキワ荘物語)
A silent reflection of Ishinomori's memories at the legendary apartments.
7. Ogawa no Medaka (小川のメダカ)
Further along in time, Ishinomori is now a father of two. Concerned about his sons' wellbeing, he tries to instill values in them by having them appreciate nature.
8. Tezuka Osamu-shi no Itta Hi (手塚治虫の逝った日)
A short manga in which Ishinomori thinks back to many things regarding Tezuka—and what him and the rest at Tokiwa-sou best knew him for.
9. Kaze no You ni… …Se wo Hashirisugita Mushi (風のように…　…背を走りすぎた虫)
After Tezuka has passed, Ishinomori assesses his interactions and relationship with Tezuka, as well as considering what it means to have a present and future without him.

175863.description:
Login between the heart and the body. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2016-06

175865.description: Hina is a very sensitive and hot-tempered college student without many friends. She returns to school after time off to immerse herself in a storm of classes and part-time jobs. One rainy day, she takes delivery of a box from an unknown sender, and finds inside a child! With pointy ears and webbed hands and feet, he's a child of the Dragon Race!

title.english: How to Raise a Dragon: 10 Methods

175866.description:
Jun is a member of the boy band Primula, the son of his agency's CEO, and the songwriter for his group. Little do they know that this is a fabrication created by the CEO. Straight off the back of their band's debut, Jun is shocked to discover that Isshin, a member of the group, is the person whose credit he has been taking. Hoping that it will help vent his anger, Jun lets Isshin have sex with him, and from that day forward places himself completely at the other man's mercy. Jun does everything he's told without complaint, saddened by Isshin's hatred for him. Soon after that, Isshin has full control over his training regimen, clothing, and even his meals. But even then, Jun fails to notice the unusual fixation Isshin has on him... The messy, muddled love story of a genius pop star and a performer with no way out!

(Source: Shinkosha)

title.english: Don't Take Your Eyes Off Me
title.native: その目を逸らしてくれるなよ
title.romaji: Sono Me wo Sorashite Kureruna yo

175870.description:
Born as the youngest of five siblings, Sakurako is 17 years old and attends an all-girls school. However, her true identity is actually… a man! Sakurako was raised as a girl by her mother who wanted a daughter, but her mother's outrageous behavior didn't stop there. Because she wanted to see Sakurako in a wedding dress, she decides to arrange for Sakurako to marry her best friend's son! Femboy high-schooler Sakurako's newlywed life?!

(Source: Prism Bunko, translated)

175871.description:
Due to her mother's outrageous desire for a daughter, Sakurako lives as a woman even though she is a man. On top of that, Sakurako is married to Kazuhiko, a popular mystery writer, so the high school boy is also a married woman. The two of them have been living a sweet married life, overcoming various obstacles, but when Kazuhiko comes to Sakurako's all-girls school as a new teacher, Sakurako's life becomes even more complicated! A rival classmate tries to seduce Kazuhiko, and Kazuhiko wants to have sex with Sakurako on campus. How will she get out of this mess?

(Source: Aqua, translated)

175873.description:
The God of Rainy Days finally saved enough vacation days for a three-year sabbatical in the human realm, and he was just starting his new life on earth, when he ran into his new neighbor who was dying from hunger. Unable to just leave her alone, he took her in and cooked dinner for her, and he thought that would be the last of it. But despite their very different daily routines, the two of them became closer when she invited him over for a meal to repay his kindness, and his secret identity as a god was exposed! The seemingly ordinary life between two neighbors seems to have become a fantastic story…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

175874.description:
Kendo is the stage. The Iwami Kendo Club is one of the top clubs in the country. Kodama, the captain, and Date, the vice-captain, are proud of their strength, but they have opposite personalities. Kodama is humble and a little timid, while Date is confident and always expects victory. These two clash in the final. What will be the outcome of their match, and what will they learn from it…?

(Source: Lemino, translated)

175875.description:
The time is Taisho era. Kawahori is a freelance assassin who relies only on an old-fashioned gun and solid killing techniques, and does not belong to any organization. The organization's top hit man, Lobo, acts hostile to Kawahori, but inwardly she has a one-sided admiration for her.

Is it fate, or just bad karma?
Lobo is ordered by the organization to assassinate Kawahori.
What will be the result of the deadly struggle for their lives...?

(Source: DLSite, translated)
synonyms: ガン・アンド・ガンレディ

175876.description:
A hidden sadist x an unaware masochist.

Izumi is perfect. Student council president, top of his class, always composed... No one would guess he’s secretly dating Ichii, his sweet, soft-spoken classmate—and the school's beloved "prince." Ichii is usually so gentle with Izumi... until the day that he isn't. And suddenly, “gentle” is no longer enough.

As Izumi discovers a different side of Ichii—and a far more confusing side of himself—the rules he’s always followed don’t seem to fit anymore… and he’s not sure he wants them to. Try as he might to deny it, some feelings refuse to stay hidden.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

175877.description:
"Hiuchu-san" is an indoors type of person by nature, and that's why she doesn't want to go outside the house very much. She's always at home every day, just idling while snacking on sweets. Naturally, such a lifestyle is accompanied by terrible effects on her figure, and so she ends up going on a certain... "Diet" with the help of her boyfriend. This is that kind of lovey-dovey story.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Released at COMIC1☆15.

175878.description:
"Nishi-san" is depressed from all the bullying she receives because of her heterochromia.

She becomes shunned by her friends and even her own mother, and as a result this emotionally cornered girl seeks help from her older brother.

What will her older brother do for the sake of his precious little sister?

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Released at COMIC1☆14.

175885.description:
Han Maru, an ordinary husband and father, dies tragically in an accident but is granted a second chance at life. With only vague memories of the past, he relives his high school days and rediscovers his passion for theater, a dream he once sacrificed. However, longing to find his wife and daughter again in this life, he fears choosing theater might steer him away from them. Juggling dreams and family, he navigates life's intricate choices, seeking fulfillment in this extraordinary second chance.

(Source: Tapas)

175887.description:
A side story to Yuutousei wa Mi no Hodo Shirazu.
After officially becoming a couple, can Kyojima and Matsuzuki balance both their school life and grades with their relationship and sex...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Released at J.GARDEN 54.

175888.description:
Transported back to her first academy days, Nerys Truydd revisits a life marred by betrayal and torment. Exploited and poisoned by her own family and husband, her demise was met with a vow to curse those who wronged her. Now granted a second chance, Nerys vows to rewrite her fate. As she navigates her past, memories of those who hurt her flood back. Determined and fueled by retribution, she seeks to reclaim all she lost. Can she overturn her tragic past and emerge victorious from the shadows of her betrayal?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Standing on stage, more cool and charming than anyone else!

Riko, skilled in dance, strives daily to fulfill her dream of becoming an "idol," especially because her twin sister Miko is often ill. But then, tragedy strikes Riko!?

(Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

175891.description:
Chiho, a young exorcist, hunts nightmares in people's dreams while balancing junior high school with partners Koi and Babuki's Kyun. Beyond his nightly duties, Chiho seeks his lost younger brother within the dream world. One day, he meets Seiichiro, a high school student wandering in others' dreams.

Hakauai Gakusha, a traditional girls' high school, is going co-ed to help increase enrollment. The centerpiece of the recruiting program is a new baseball team, but the famous coach who was hired to build the team suddenly passes away! Now the new coach and the fifteen remaining members of the team are thrown into the fierce competition of high school baseball! A new baseball team's search for victory begins!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

175900.description: A new anchor is forced to put her career on the line by engaging in underground competitive sex duels against other women where their body fluids become aphrodisiacs, improving her sexual prowess and employing desperate tactics against opponents. The victor would receive "compensation". The protagonist vows to only use the "compensation'' for reporting purposes... If she wins, she can obtain the "compensation'', but if she loses, she will be socially ruined as a punishment.

Tang Yu transmigrated into the world of an urban novel as its rich heir villain. He was just going along with the plot, trying to enjoy life as a rich playboy, when the female characters all heard his private thoughts about the situation! Now all of them have broken character to come on to him! Hey, I'm just trying to make it through the story until the happy ending! Help!

175902.description:
Nicolas has started a new life in a new city, and is ready to leave his past behind. One of the first people he meets is the mysterious Al, a man who has trouble making decisions. He recruits Nicolas to be his "decision maker" and help him decide what to do every day, from what to eat for breakfast to what to wear to work. Although the decisions seem innocuous at first, Nicolas can't help but sense that something sinister is going on behind the scenes...

(Source: Animate International)

175903.description:
In 2018, monsters swarmed Seoul, and heroic “players” saved the city. Fast forward a decade, Hyukjin Kim, stuck in a seven-year rut after failing to become a player himself, gets a do-over. Zapped back to 2018, Hyukjin seizes his chance to rewrite history. With knowledge from the future and his re-awakened player talents, Hyukjin battles beasts and conquers dungeons in a pulse-pounding quest for redemption and survival!

(Source: Tapas)

175904.description:
Shoto Kazama, a boy who has never been able to win at card games because of his habit of giving up on things easily, enters the immersive world of Digimon Liberator through the invitation of his childhood friend, Arisa Kinosaki. The game allows players to engage in highly realistic card battles. At first, Shoto is hesitant towards it, but through his engrossing encounters with the Digimon there, he becomes a fan of the game. ——This is a story about Digimon, and the world.

(Source: Digimon Card Game Official Site)

Note: A prologue (named "Chapter 0") was published on March 10th, 2024 on the Digimon Liberators website before the official start date, which was in April 25th, 2024.

175910.description:
Ousuke Akiyoshi is a young model with no motivation. Even after being chosen for a special feature by an extremely popular photographer, Shogo Nowaki, he doesn't seem to care. However, on the day of the shoot, Shogo tells Ousuke that he's not beautiful anymore. Filled with anger, Ousuke goes to his hotel and confronts him, but it leads to a very different situation. Shogo's penetrating eyes reveal Ousuke's true self and warm his cold heart.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Her smile hides her obscene desires. ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

175913.description:
Mu-Wan and Wu-Yi have been doing well since getting together. At least, as far as Wu-Yi is concerned. Mu-Wan, on the other hand, can't help but feel restricted in the bedroom out of fear of hurting Wu-Yi. It's a hard topic to approach, but Mu-Wan will need to figure it out before resentment claims this newly minted relationship.

(Source: Tapas)

175916.description:
On an April night in Tokyo, still too early for fireworks, university student Kakeru Sorano meets a woman named Koharu Fuyutsuki. She is a beautiful girl who stands out from the crowd, laughs a lot, and exudes a warmth that contrasts sharply with Kakeru's own introversion. But there was something Kakeru didn't know at first—she can't see.

Unlike Kakeru, Koharu hasn't given up on anything, even with her blindness. She attends university daily, shows interest in clubs, makes friends—and dreams of launching fireworks one day. Kakeru wonders why, when she can't see them...but maybe it doesn't matter. And maybe he can start moving forward, too, for the girl who's always been by his side

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Winner of the Grand Prize award in the 15th GA Bunko Taisho.

175917.description:
After meeting for 0 seconds, a proposal!? One night Hana Kayama opens her door to a strange young man standing there, Keito Mikita. Moreover, he plainly proposes to her saying "May we please live together, as a married couple?" Hana thinks it's super suspicious, but it turns out he's actually the younger brother of an old friend! She wonders if the proposal is true or not, but for some reason, she can't abandon this man without a home, so they start living together!! This is a reunion with a boy who turned into a man, but what should this grown woman do with his 10 years of "true love"!?

(Source: INKR)

Doom came to Shin Young-jun, a cook sergeant, just a few days before his final vacation. The battalion turned into chaos in an instant, and the communication network was cut off. There is only one thing visible before your eyes! [Congratulations on your awakening!] [Job: New Chef Lv.1] If I had been a warrior or an assassin, I would have tried to stand alone... What was given to him was a chef, which is obviously a support job. There's nothing I can do when it's like this. 'From now on, I will feed you.'

175935.description:
Yuuka wanted to become a popular idol, but her career never took off and she had to give up on her dream. She is now working a regular job, when her former manager tries to invite her to get into AV!? When she has trouble dissuading her persistent manager, a handsome stranger comes to her rescue! And then he moves in next door to her apartment!? He must be hiding something from her!

175936.description:
Return to the wonderful world of Speros Island, and meet the newly wedded Alexei and Bliss "Billie" Drakos. Within hours, their marriage hits a big storm when Billie confesses to Alexei that her nephew, Nikolos, is actually her-and Alexei's-son from a night of unforgettable passion. Except Alexei doesn't remember... He fell down the stairs, hit his head and developed amnesia! Will Alexei accept Niko as his own, or will he run to the arms of the conniving Calisto? Billie is determined to steer the course of this stormy Greek marriage...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

175937.description:
It is the year 203X, and Junwoo is a pro at "Over the Fantasy," a virtual reality game. One of his secret strategies is to keep an alternate character for extra inventory space to store his main characters' shiny items. But one unlucky day, a server error traps him inside the game—and as Dio, the classless alternate character! The situation seems dire, but he has an inventory teeming with SSS-class items to help him survive in this fantasy world. They should be enough to keep him going... Right?

(Source: Tapas)

175946.description:
All Jeong wants is a second chance – for revenge! His grandfather’s gruesome death has transformed him into the bloodthirsty and ruthless Scythe Demon. He will stop at nothing until he has killed the man responsible. Yet rage and determination alone are not enough. He must train in martial arts if he ever wants to stand a chance against such a formidable foe. Will he succeed in his revenge on the murderer of his grandfather?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Chaotic God of Extraordinary Strength

175947.description:
Yun-Oh has only one person in the world who he can rely on: his hyung, Hae-Won. For years, Yun-Oh has harbored a secret, unrequited love for Hae-Won, who is not only someone he considers family but also his sole protector. As a beta, Yun-Oh believes a future with Hae-Won, an alpha, is impossible, so he keeps his feelings buried deep and stays quietly by his side. But when Hae-Won unexpectedly goes into rut, Yun-Oh is caught up in the whirlwind, and his carefully hidden emotions are laid bare.

What will become of their fragile bond when Hae-Won discovers the truth Yun-Oh has tried so desperately to conceal?

(Source: Lezhin US)

175948.description:
Goho Aoshima is an ordinary first-year high school boy with no special qualities. He is plain-looking, athletically inept, and friendless. When he confesses his feelings to a girl, he is promptly rejected, and just when he thinks he has no chance, the man of his dreams appears......! When he joins a painting class to follow the girl he likes, he meets a mysterious ghost who calls himself "Van Gogh"...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

175949.description:
Yun Ha-Jun, who struggled to pursue his musical career despite his iffy talents and ended up sacrificing his own family along the way.

"If only I could turn back time...! "

One day, after living with regrets and alcohol for a while, he woke up and found himself had returned to the past. Just then, it dawned on him.

The fact that my younger sister is a musical genius...! Now is the time to turn my life around, by producing my younger sister into becoming the best singer!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: My Younger Sibling Was a Genius
My Younger Sister Was a Genius

175951.description:
Yu Geon is just a normal teenager, were it not for the fact that he's dying from a disease that gives him excruciating pain but also blesses him with supernatural strength. And despite his best efforts to focus on his illness and avoid the troublesome criminals and delinquents at his school, he has no choice but to intervene when their schemes cause a classmate to get kidnapped. Sick of their behavior, Geon decides to put an end to their crimes... even if it's the last thing he ever does.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: Dawn of the God of War

175952.description: The sealed myths and legends have returned to reality. A world where all gods and dragons are liberated, and demons and ghosts have come back. The awakening of humans. The emergence of heroes. A new era of mythology has opened. This story is a narrative about the war and love of the heroes who live in the new era of mythology, or perhaps a new myth.

175954.description:
There’s only so much one can take of her friend squealing over yet another cliché romance fantasy novel. But the biggest cliché of all happens when Ji-Won and Yein reincarnate with Si-Hyeon in the exact story their friend is so obsessed with! Though God has summoned them to this new world to save it from impending doom, the three women have other plans. Ji-Won wishes to rebel against the imperial palace, Si-Hyeon gets romantically tied up with the crown prince, and Yein is busy literally tying up her new submissive boy toy…

(Source: Tappytoon)

When he regained consciousness, was his appearance reflected in the mirror the cutest version of himself from when he was 5 years old?

Yasuo is a shut-in living in the same apartment complex as three elementary school girls, whom he names "F3" (short for "Flower Three"). When he's not fantasizing about the girls, he enjoys observing and recording them from his window. One day, Yasuo sneaks into the girls' locker room at their school swimming pool and installs a hidden camera. Later, as he excitedly plays back the captured footage, what shows up on the screen is something he never expected to see.

"Watch out for the guy with the ponytail,” a warning Lee Myung-il heard on his first day in prison. But when he unintentionally rescues the central figure of the rumors, Choi Jingi, it takes an unexpected turn. And with Jingi’s younger brother, Heonjae, involved, things get even messier...

(Source: Lezhin US)

175966.description:
I'm sorry you're stuck liking a burdensome woman like me, but I have no intention of letting you go.
Saionji Reine, a prince-like beauty with silver hair and tall stature. Admired by both men and women, she is the complete opposite of an introverted guy like me. I never thought I would get involved with her—but...

"I'm definitely going to make you fall for me, so please be prepared."

After helping her when she was in trouble, I ended up being pursued by her because she fell in love with me!? Despite my feelings of inferiority, I am gradually falling in love with her due to her skilled manipulations.

175973.description:
When their regular homeroom teacher is hospitalized, a substitute teacher arrives. This teacher is a snow woman with a strange constitution who melts and turns into a child when she gets nervous, only turning back into an adult after she cools down… And what's worse, she's a bit clumsy… Is this yuki-onna sensei going to be alright?

(Source: Magcomi, translated)

175974.description:
Kuromatsu is a former great shortstop who is planning to retire from pro ball at the end of the season. Fujishima, a former high school acquaintance, sought him out and took him to meet Aizu, Kuromatsu's second baseman from 15 years ago. Kuromatsu is so fired up that he begins to take practice at shortstop once again… Who says you can't get up and play at 40! This is a manga that will inspire you to go out and play catch!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

175975.description:
Yeomin Chae has been living in the shadow of her stepsister, Nari Chae, ever since they were kids. One day, Seungjae, Yeomin's ex-boyfriend, tells her that he’s marrying Nari out of the blue. After being betrayed by the person she trusted most, she runs into Hwan Yun, who is the grandson of Taeju Group’s chairman. Frustrated with her life, she suggests to Hwan that he marry her. As the two decide to get married, what exciting events and struggles will they encounter?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

175976.description:
A singer becomes an idol―?

Akira is scouted by sMiLea Productions, an agency set up by the suddenly retired legendary idol Anela, to form a new group with Banri and Chihiro. Come and take a peek at the lively days of these three boys with sparkling personalities, in the three-man boy-band PROTOSTAR!

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

175978.description:
Once upon a time, there were three beautiful maidens, three sisters who lived together in harmony. Yaeko, the eldest, and Tsubomi, the third, were dainty maidens who loved fashion. Hanae, the middle sister, was a plain-looking girl on the outside, but she was beautiful on the inside. And then, decades passed… They are now living happily in "Cattleya Garden," a nursing home. Yaeko and Tsubomi may look wrinkled on the outside, but they still love to dress up, and they still shop for cute clothes at stores for young women. Even Hanae would not outdone. Although she was the plainest of the sisters, she has been married seven times! Even at her age, she still falls in love, and even goes to Comiket because she is crazy about the yaoi manga that her grandchildren like! A girl is still a girl no matter how old she is! The three sisters are enjoying their second youth with full grandma power! This is a unique work that positively portrays women living in an aging society!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

175980.description:
Oshio is a medical representative known as the "King of Eating Out" of Sakaiwa Pharmaceuticals, well-known across hospitals for his penchant for knowing everything about restaurants, bars and cafes. Unfortunately, he's not the only one with this specific skill - another medical representative at their rival company Ferma Pharmaceuticals might just know more about food than he does!

(Source: Manga Planet)

High school teacher Yukino has a sexless marriage with her husband and leads an unfulfilling life due to her own sexual preferences. 175989.description:
One day, Haruka Fujimi, a popular high school girl who is a model and an influencer, decides to make a movie, thanks to the suggestions of her senior at school, Chiharu Enjoji. However, it turns out to be a "special effects movie" with people walking around in monster suits and models exploding all over the place! Haruka felt tricked by Chiharu, but she becomes friends with the unique members of the club and starts to see the charm of their special effects...?

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

175990.description:
Shy college student Shizuka moonlights as "Shiro" online, anonymously broadcasting erotic content to his followers. Of all his followers, "Kuro" is by far his favorite: a dark-haired hottie who's always first to leave a comment. One night, while fantasizing about Kuro, a fateful misdial leads Shizuka to accidentally masturbate to an audience of one.

"Kuro" then reveals himself to be Kurosaki, Shizuka's classmate and Mr. Popular! Thinking he's being blackmailed, Shizuka agrees to be Kurosaki's project partner, but Kurosaki has an agenda of his own in mind... Now that Kurosaki knows Shiro's identity, just how far will Shizuka go to make sure his secret account stays secret...?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

One day, he learns that the Statice Tokyo has an extremely talented chief concierge, Mamiya, who "never refuses to do anything a guest requests". Rye is intrigued by the fact that Mamiya does not change his personality even when he makes unreasonable requests, so he asks her to have sex with him. Then, he is served the best sex services...?

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Enya and Tarhan are forever bonded once Enya helps Tarhan's family find peace after a tragic accident. However, their bond is challenged when Tarhan goes from a distrusted outsider to the strong and popular vice chief of Agilea. In a society where a healthy body is considered one's greatest asset, Enya is treated with scorn because of her limp. On top of that, her place as Tarhan's lover is threatened when the princess of an ally tribe offers a marriage alliance in times of impending war. Will Enya and Tarhan's love prevail despite the numerous obstacles in their rocky path?
